scope: Independent files-only semantic and lineage review of fourteen existing direct-runtime/attachRag observations; no runtime, product imports, model calls, DB opens, tests or raw edits. Standard-library JSON/byte reads only.

findings.finding: Actual same-preset heading0 to -30 and new primary/route are established. EQ-002 was eligible, ranked by FTS/vector/fusion and supplied to actual Qwen alongside EQ-001. Raw responses selected index0 (EQ-001). The accepted and current published KO/EN explanations exactly match reviewed EQ-001 and preserve the engine primary fields. This is not evidence of a wrong applicability gate. EQ-002-specific actual accepted/publication coverage remains unobserved; do not convert it to PASS or force selection.
findings.validAlternateBasis: EQ-001 full body applies to equipment-assessed EQUIPMENT-A exposure with known worker position and current valid engine route/destination. Both direction cases have known WORKER-A, actual load hazard, FOLLOW_VALIDATED_ROUTE and a valid REFUGE-02 route.

findings.finding: All ten negative observations carry both facts false and exclude EQ-002 and FG-002 from current eligible/ranked/model-input/result/current-publication stages. First-fire and fire profile-only cases use reviewed FG-004 under explicit evacuation and valid route; initial equipment uses EQ-001. Direction profile-only cases use GUIDANCE_UPDATED, empty hazardTypes and no_match with no model invocation.

Prior north route exists before virtual8000. Same-time PATH-B block and FIRE-ZONE-B growth invalidate that old route; the south/east replacement avoids the expanded fire and matches captured engine route. Same-run/worker primary1/route1 becomes primary3/route2, explicit evacuation retained. Actual model selects FG-002 and current supplement4 publishes the exact reviewed KO/EN sentence. Attribution is joint fire growth/closure, not initial first fire or closure label alone.

FG post-event profile-only artifacts retain older FG-002 rows in guidance_evidence under a stable guidanceId. New primary5/supplement6 contains only FG-004, and its retrieval/model/result excludes FG-002. Historical table membership alone must not be relabeled as a new-primary publication failure.

joinMethod: ServiceCallIndex joins provider wrapper captures. Generation row joins exact ragRunId, then callId plus provider-message hash to proxy; request/response bytes hashed independently. Retrieval joins same run, exact facts, service interval and resident embedding output vector; no-embedding no_match joins empty-vector retrieval in that exact interval. First primary re-located from raw history by run/worker/guidanceId/primaryGuidanceVersion. Stable guidanceId and responseHash alone are insufficient: many selection0 responses share the same message hash.
limits: No overall candidate acceptance or original85 reassessment is issued.
Direct durable/runtime publication only; captured engine transmission attempts have zero connected subscriptions, so this does not establish HTTP/SSE delivery or physical UI/audio.
The fourteen controlled09:30/live eligible comparisons were observed equal for these requests only; no global time equivalence is inferred.
EQ-002 actual-model acceptance and current EQ-002 publication remain unobserved in both causal direction cases.
Captured booleans were corroborated with raw snapshots/events; no production fact, query, corpus, source approval or raw result was changed.
